data.one_liner: Customizable rating bar widget for Flutter with support for custom icons and half ratings.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable rating bar widget for Flutter applications. Supports custom icons, half icons, layout directions, alignments, and read-only modes.
use_when: You need a user interface component for users to submit ratings.
You need to display static product or content ratings in a read-only mode.
avoid_when: You require complex form validation integrations beyond standard callbacks.
weaknesses: Limited feature set outside of basic rating display and input

alternatives.name: flutter_rating_bar
alternatives.why_pick_it: Another popular alternative package for rating bars in Flutter.

data.minimal_example:
RatingBar(
  filledIcon: Icons.star, 
  emptyIcon: Icons.star_border,
  onRatingChanged: (value) => debugPrint('$value'),
  initialRating: 3,
  maxRating: 5,
)
